reborn-0126.rationale: Current English text says Arcana Force 0 - The Fool cannot be changed to Defense Position, while the legacy engine text explicitly adds 'except with a card effect.' Official Japanese Neuron Q&A clarifies the intended rule: the continuous effect prevents the turn player's ordinary Main Phase battle-position change from changing The Fool to Defense Position, but other card effects can change its battle position. The pinned Lua registers EFFECT_CANNOT_CHANGE_POSITION while The Fool is face-up in Attack Position, matching that engine rule distinction. The remaining battle-indestructibility and coin-result effects correspond to the same current card behavior, so the wording difference does not represent a simulator behavior mismatch.

note: Hash-bound wording review using official Neuron Q&A to resolve Arcana Force 0 - The Fool's battle-position wording.
